senses.gloss:
वैध वैध, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विधि), enjoined
by rule, conformable to rule, prescribed, appointed,
giving rules or directions, preceptive, ritual; legal.

वैधिक, अस्, ई, अम्, in accordance with rule,
giving precepts or commands, preceptive, ritual.

वैधर्म्य वैधर्म्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-धर्म),
unlawfulness, injustice, impropriety, irreligion, hete-
rodoxy; difference of duty or obligation; opposition
or contrariety of character, difference of characteristic
qualities, difference, heterogeneity.

वैधव वैधव, अस्, m. (fr. विधु), the son
of the Moon, i. e. Budha.

वैधव्य वैधव्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-धवा),
widowhood.
वैधवेय, अस्, m. the son of a widow.

वैधात्र वैधात्र, अस्, m. (fr. वि-धातृ), a
patronymic of Sanat-kumāra (as son of Brahmā and
eldest of the progenitors of mankind); (ई), f. =
ब्राह्मी, q. v.

वैधुर्य वैधुर्य, अम्, n. (fr. विधुर), agi-
tation, tremulousness.

वैधूमाग्नी वैधूमाग्नी, f., N. of a city in
the country of the Śālvas.

वैधृत वैधृत, अस्, m. (fr. वि-धृत), N.
of a particular position of the sun and moon when
they are on the same side of either solstice and of
equal declination but of opposite direction, (this is
considered a malignant aspect; cf. व्य्-अतीपात.)

वैधृति, इस्, f. the Yoga star of the twenty-
seventh lunar mansion; = वैधृत above.

वैधेय 1. वैधेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-धेय),
foolish, silly, weak, ignorant; (अस्), m. an idiot, fool.

2. वैधेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विधि), relating to
rule or precept, prescribed, preceptive; (अस्), m., N.
of a teacher of the White Yajur-veda.

वैध्यत वैध्यत, अस्, m., N. of Yama's
porter or door-keeper.
